name: bot-conduct
description: Living checklist + working rules for agent bots, organized by lifecycle moment: STARTING a task (worktree, Plane task in-progress + assigned to the current cycle (Week N), session rename), DURING work (subagent-first, Agent: commit trailer, three-copy doctrine, push release commits immediately, channel discipline), and BEFORE idle/handoff/done (everything pushed, merge or record the merge obligation in the handoff, Plane task done, durable lessons to the vault). Rationale and the full shared-repo git discipline live in the skill's references/. A PreToolUse hook mechanically enforces the Agent: commit trailer.
